close_comment: Evidence: generate-memory-provider-rust.py reads only the accepted contract-set and six canonical contracts, emits one dependency-free generated Rust authority plus a source/generator/output digest manifest, and supports exact --write/--check regeneration. The generated module forbids unsafe code and denies warnings, missing docs, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, dbg, and print macros; it contains contract/capability specs, canonical required-field constants, closed wire enums, validated provider/capability identities, exact scope, request control, opaque extensions, and terminal summaries without transport or concrete-provider logic. check-memory-provider-rust-bindings.py verifies every digest/count/path, zero generator drift, required types/constants, forbidden constructs, rustc 2024 library compilation, a runtime identity/enum probe, and duplicate declarations across future product crates. Mutation tests corrupt headers, source, lints, required types/constants, manifests, digests, and duplicate scan roots. product-memory-contracts.yml mirrors its product-owned template and runs every contract test/checker, canonical golden drift, generated Rust drift/compile, patch policy, and clean-tree proof on push and PR.
